- Gallery: the photo viewer's zoom is written again from the start. The page's zoom arithmetic is one small class (where the picture lies: its zoom and its move, never beyond the page's edges), and the picture is drawn straight onto a canvas at the place it gives, no longer through a scaled layer. Two fingers zoom and move the picture, one finger moves it only while zoomed (at the whole picture the pager turns the page), a double tap or the zoom button zooms in on the point touched and back out, a long press or the chip plays a LIVE picture. The zoom goes up to the level set in the settings (never less than 4x). The picture is read once at 2048 px on its long edge.
